title: A Neural Score-Based Particle Method for the Vlasov-Maxwell-Landau System
summary: Plasma modeling is central to the design of nuclear fusion reactors, yet simulating collisional plasma kinetics from first principles remains a formidable computational challenge: the Vlasov-Maxwell-Landau (VML) system describes six-dimensional phase-space transport under self-consistent electromagnetic fields together with the nonlinear, nonlocal Landau collision operator. A recent deterministic particle method for the full VML system estimates the velocity score function via the blob method, a kernel-based approximation with $O(n^2)$ cost.
